study.title: Restless Legs Syndrome: Current Concepts in Diagnosis and Treatment

cover.headline: **Alpha-2-delta drugs have replaced dopamine agonists** as the go-to treatment for restless legs syndrome

slides.title: If you or someone you know has restless legs syndrome, the first pill your doctor reaches for should have changed
slides.body:
Alpha-2-delta drugs are now preferred first-line therapy, displacing dopamine agonists. The shift follows evidence that dopamine agonists carry big long-term risk of worsening symptoms.

The 2025 sleep medicine guideline formalizes the change. Treatment now starts with finding triggers, fixing iron, then adding tailored medicine.

slides.title: Restless legs syndrome affects seven percent of adults worldwide and substantially impacts sleep and quality of life
slides.body:
The review consolidates recent evidence on diagnosis and care. The key shift: dopamine agonists are out as preferred chronic therapy. Alpha-2-delta drugs now lead.

A stepwise approach starting with triggers and iron status offers the best outcomes across the disease spectrum.

caveats: This is a clinical review summarizing existing evidence and guidelines, not a new experimental study with original data.
The abstract does not detail how much alpha-2-delta drugs reduce symptoms or how often worsening occurs with dopamine agonists.

source.abstract: Restless legs syndrome (RLS) is a common sensorimotor disorder affecting approximately 7% of adults globally, with substantial impact on sleep and quality of life. This review covers the epidemiology, pathophysiology, diagnosis, and evidence-based management of RLS, with emphasis on recent developments: the 2025 American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM) systematic review and guideline, and the consolidation of alpha-2-delta ligands as preferred first-line therapy. Alpha-2-delta ligands have replaced dopamine agonists as preferred first-line chronic therapy, given the significant long-term risk of augmentation. A stepwise approach that starts with identifying exacerbating factors, continues optimizing iron, then adds tailored pharmacotherapy, offers the best outcomes across the disease spectrum.
